text:
Maya: Morning all — quick async.
1) what I did: wired up new quickstart for node + ESM, added README snippets for token auth, landed sample app scaffolding in samples/node-quickstart. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/342
2) blockers: CI flakes on macOS wheel build (failing on test 'pkg:install'), need someone to rerun mac CI or advise workaround
3) today: address CI, finish doc examples for TypeScript, and open an eval set for the quickstart.

Alex: Nice — I'll take a look at the PR later today. Can you paste the failing test log? @Maya

Maya: Sure, paste below:
```
Error: EXIT 1 — missing binary wheel for macosx_11_0_x86_64
Running: pip wheel . --no-deps
```
Haven't reproduced locally on M1, only on CI x86 mac runner.

Sam: I'll re-trigger the mac builder, leaving a note in the PR. If it persists I can try building on x86 VM.

Chris: Small docs nit: in quickstart README, the env var examples use REDWOOD_API_KEY but our SDK uses REDWOOD_KEY now. Can we standardize? I can send a one-line fix.

Maya: Good catch — I switched variable names across samples to REDWOOD_KEY. I must have missed README in that folder, thx.

Alex: Also can we add a tiny snippet showing streaming responses? People ask that a lot. A 3-line example would be perfect.

Maya: Yep — will add streaming snippet under "Advanced usage" and link to streaming cheat-sheet.

DevEx Bot: PR #342 linked CI:macos — re-run requested by Sam — status: queued :white_check_mark:

Sam: Quick question — anyone have a small prompt set we could use for the eval? I'm thinking 10 edge-case prompts for instruction-following.

Chris: I can drop 12 prompts into /docs/evals/quickstarts/samples.json today. Will ping when done.

Alex: No blockers from me. FYI I'll review the PR after lunch. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks all — if no objections I'll merge once CI green and Chris' prompts are in. Setting a reminder to close the follow-up tasks. /me out
